targetText: Consequently the length of the turnover period increases in proportion to the length of the production time that does not consist of working time.
explanation: Capital turnover time consists of production time plus circulation time; reducing turnover time accelerates the annual rate of profit accumulation.

targetText: It is here not a question of interruptions of the labour-process necessitated by natural limitations of the labour-power itself, although we have seen to what extent the mere circumstance that fixed capital ; factory buildings, machinery, etc.
explanation: Fixed capital transfers its value gradually over multiple production cycles (e.g. factory machinery), while circulating capital transfers its entire value in a single cycle (raw materials/wages).
